_note: Heuristic sink/entrypoint patterns for the AI code-audit's deterministic analyst. Kept as DATA (not Python) on purpose: codescan/*.py is source-scanned for dangerous literals (os.system, eval(, subprocess.run, requests.), and a detector that hard-codes those tokens would trip its own static-only lock. Loading them from JSON keeps ai_audit.py clean while the detector still recognises them in SCANNED code. These drive only the no-LLM fallback / demo path; the LLM agent does the real audit.

sinks.title: OS command injection
sinks.attacker_path: An external request reaches {ep} and its attacker-controlled input flows into a shell command at {loc} without escaping. An attacker appends `; <cmd>` (or `$( )`) to run arbitrary commands as the service account.
sinks.impact: Remote code execution on the host running the service.

sinks.title: Server-side request forgery
sinks.attacker_path: The handler at {ep} passes attacker-controlled input into an outbound HTTP request at {loc}. An attacker supplies an internal URL (e.g. the cloud metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254) to reach services the app can see but they cannot.
sinks.impact: Access to internal services and cloud metadata / IAM credentials (SSRF -> cloud creds).

sinks.title: SQL injection via string-built query
sinks.attacker_path: A SQL query at {loc}, reachable from {ep}, is assembled by string interpolation rather than a bound parameter. An attacker injects `' OR '1'='1` (or a UNION/stacked query) into the tainted parameter.
sinks.impact: Database read/write, authentication bypass, or full data exfiltration.

sinks.title: Dynamic code evaluation of untrusted input
sinks.attacker_path: Attacker-controlled input reaching {ep} is evaluated as code/deserialised at {loc}. A crafted payload executes arbitrary Python in the app process.

sinks.title: Path traversal in file access
sinks.attacker_path: A filename derived from request input at {ep} is opened at {loc} with no canonicalisation. An attacker supplies `../../etc/passwd` to read files outside the intended directory.
sinks.impact: Arbitrary file read (and, with a write sink, arbitrary file write).

sinks.title: Authentication check against a hard-coded secret
sinks.attacker_path: The authorization check at {loc}, guarding {ep}, compares against a constant secret baked into source. Anyone who reads the source (or guesses the value) authenticates.
